info.name: DBU Handoff Service — local
info.description:
Drives the handoff service running on localhost with both vendors replaced by the logging stand-ins (handoff.vendors.mode=logging). Nothing leaves the machine.

Run the requests in order. Set logging.level.com.dbu.handoff=DEBUG in application.properties first, or the stand-ins' output is invisible.

The webhook requests sign themselves in a pre-request script. The signature is sha256= plus the BASE64 HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, which is what GenesysSignatureVerifier checks and what the Genesys team's own collection produces.

variable.description: Change this to start a clean journey — one open handoff per customer is enforced by the database.
